tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: App background. A warm, slightly grey paper in light; a soft black in dark.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Plain white cards and sheets on paper, when a sticker colour would be too loud.

tokens.name: reader-paper
tokens.usage: Background of the Scripture reading screen only.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All primary text, the primary button fill, progress lines, and hairlines at full strength. 16:1 on paper.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, verse numbers, on paper, card and reader-paper (5:1 or more).

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an ink fill, such as the primary button.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between list rows. Decorative only.

tokens.name: flare
tokens.usage: The one loud colour: streak days, today markers, achievement stickers, the reading dot. Never for body text.

tokens.name: sticker-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on every sticker colour (flare, butter, sky, sage, rose, lilac) in both themes, 6:1 or more.

tokens.name: on-sticker-ink
tokens.usage: Text on a sticker-ink fill, such as the primary button inside a sticker card, in both themes.

tokens.name: butter
tokens.usage: Sticker colour: the Today card and verse highlight.

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Sticker colour: sequential plans and reflections.

tokens.name: sage
tokens.usage: Sticker colour: introductory plans and completed states.

tokens.name: rose
tokens.usage: Sticker colour: thematic plans.

tokens.name: lilac
tokens.usage: Sticker colour: Psalms and poetry, saved verses.

tokens.name: ultra
tokens.usage: Links, keyboard focus, and the selected verse underline (6:1 or more on paper).

tokens.name: alert
tokens.usage: Form errors only, always with a message.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: Background behind a highlighted verse in the reader; ink stays readable on it.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Overlay behind sheets.

styles.name: mega
styles.usage: One huge number per screen: streak count, plan percentage.

styles.name: tag
styles.usage: Small uppercase tags and sticker text.

styles.name: title-italic
styles.usage: Editorial headlines and passage titles on cards. Lowercase is allowed for warmth.

styles.name: scripture
styles.sample: Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.
styles.usage: Scripture body, adjustable from 16px to 28px; keep line height at 1.7.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Pick up where you left off.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between tags; title to caption.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: List row padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Sticker card padding; between blocks.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Reader top and bottom margins; completion screens.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Text fields (underline only), list rows, reader.

tokens.name: radius-sticker
tokens.usage: Sticker cards: Today, plans, milestones.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, tags, switches, streak dots.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target.

tokens.name: button-height
tokens.usage: Primary button height.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Rule and outline width.

tokens.name: reader-measure
tokens.usage: Maximum Scripture line length.
